text:
Marcos: Quick planning thread for NimbleApps pilot + broader roadmap prioritization. Need final scope, launch gates, and a prioritized backlog for Optimize Toolkit features this quarter.
Evelyn: TLDR of what I think we must ship for pilot: batching presets, prefix cache toggles, two quant presets, eval-alert plumbing + golden set runner.
Priyanka: Customer asks: NimbleApps requires visible cost reduction and no user-facing regressions. They want a staged rollout with clear rollback triggers.
Marcos: Prioritization: Must-haves for pilot vs Postpilot.
- MUST: batch-safe + batch-econ presets, prefix cache opt-in per-route, q8 preset, eval-alert + golden-set gating
- SHOULD: q4 aggressive preset behind flag, per-customer cost projection dashboard, auto-tuning recommender
- NICE: UI in Console to toggle presets, in-UI golden-set viewer
Harrison: Ops constraints: we can support two parallel canaries per customer without infra churn. Recommend canary A (latency-sensitive) and canary B (cost-focused).
Evelyn: For metrics, propose we collect: per-route p50/p95/p99, tokens, cost_estimate, cache_hit_ratio, task_metric, quant_perp_delta, and hallucination_rate (annotated sample).
Priyanka: Acceptance for NimbleApps pilot (customer-facing):
- econ: projected monthly cost delta >= 15% on pilot traffic
- quality: seeded golden-set drop <= 1.0% absolute OR human-review score delta <= 0.6/5
- stability: no primary eval-alerts for 48h; if any primary alert fires twice in 12h -> auto-rollback
Evelyn: Eval-alert config draft (will PR):
```
primary_metric: "task_accuracy"
baseline_window_days: 14
alert_drop_abs: 0.01
check_window_minutes: 30
min_samples: 60
embedding_warn_cosine_shift: 0.017
```
Marcos: Scope negotiation with Sales: we promised Console toggles for presets but that can be postpilot if we ship CLI/SDK flags and docs for pilot. Let's table Console UX to next sprint.
Priyanka: CS note: NimbleApps will provide 250 golden prompts and a whitelist of cacheable endpoints by EOD Tuesday. They insisted on TTL <= 30m for caches during pilot.
Harrison: Rollback runbook: immediate traffic switch to baseline model variant + disable batching and cache flags. I'll own an automated playbook that flips the feature flag and terminates warm processes.
AuditBot: security check: ensure prefix cache keys avoid PII — require CS signoff per endpoint.
Marcos: Roadmap priorities (this quarter): 1) pilot delivery (must), 2) cost dashboard (should), 3) console toggles + audit logs (should), 4) quant q4 behind flag (nice).
Evelyn: Experiment plan: split traffic 50/50 to canary A/B for 48h, collect telemetry and run golden-set nightly. We'll tag metrics with `experiment:nimble-pilot-1778888888`.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled -> pilot/nimbleapps/1778888888 (status: scheduled) :calendar:
Priyanka: Action items: @Evelyn (PR for eval config + telemetry schema), @Harrison (rollback playbook + feature-flag endpoint), @Marcos (update sales commit and pilot kickoff doc), @Priyanka (collect golden prompts + cache whitelist).
Marcos: OK — locking scope: no Console work for pilot; must-haves only. We'll reconvene 24h after pilot start to evaluate. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
